items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1974-03-28
items.q: Dorthy and what that was there was, the Piavels, Butter Beans and Suze, the Palace Theatre.

ctx.x: They never didn't have that stuff at the, did they come to town?
Butter Beans and Suze, sure they came to, when they had the Palace Theatre, Dorthy and what that was there was, the Piavels, Butter Beans and Suze, the Palace Theatre.
